Hana Kim is a Senior Backend Engineer at NexaTech Solutions, a startup where she’s been a key player in scaling their platform. She’s the go-to person for solving complex system challenges, and her work consistently aligns with the team’s goals.  

Hana’s technical expertise shines in her work with AWS, where she optimized cost by 30% through spot instance usage during non-peak hours. She’s also built critical services in Go, reducing latency by 40% in a real-time data processing pipeline. Her Kubernetes deployments automate scaling, cutting manual intervention time in half. She owns the microservices architecture, splitting a monolith into modular services that improved scalability by 60% during a recent surge. PostgreSQL optimization under her guidance boosted query performance by 50%, and her REST APIs, designed with clarity in mind, have driven a 200% increase in third-party integrations.  

She collaborates seamlessly across teams, translating technical jargon into actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders. Her adaptability in a fast-paced startup environment ensures she meets tight deadlines without compromising quality.  

Hana’s contributions have directly reduced infrastructure costs by $250K annually and improved system reliability by 95%. Her work ethic is unwavering—she’s the first to volunteer for late-night fixes and prioritizes documentation to onboard new team members efficiently.  

If you’re seeking someone who balances deep technical skills with pragmatic problem-solving, Hana is an exceptional candidate. She’s reliable, results-driven, and a joy to work with. I’d wholeheartedly recommend her.
